name: gajendra
description: One clear focus across your AI tools.

interface.longDescription: One NOW. One short queue. One click back to the exact thread. Organize local AI-agent threads with Focus and Important priorities, provider-reported Running and Ready for Review, exact-response acknowledgement with Undo, and explicit Finish/Reopen and continuation history. The Codex plugin and optional macOS companion share your local state. Requires Node.js and locally installed providers; Claude Code discovery is opt-in. Gajendra stores bounded priorities and disposable metadata, never prompts or transcripts. Cloud-only sessions and mobile access are not supported.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open Gajendra and help me choose the one AI-agent thread I should focus on now.

positive.prompt: Open Gajendra and show my current focus.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the local catalog and current priorities; label saved metadata and report unavailable sources without removing priorities.

positive.prompt: Put the thread I selected in Focus and make it NOW.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact returned canonical ID, keep one NOW in open Focus, and persist the confirmed change.

positive.prompt: I reviewed this exact response. Clear it from Ready for Review.
positive.expected_behavior: Require fresh exact-response evidence, keep priority unchanged, and preserve a newer response if it arrives.
Only explicit user intent finishes work. Clear NOW if applicable; do not promote another task or discard pending review.

positive.prompt: Continue this work in the successor thread I selected.
positive.expected_behavior: Validate both returned IDs; retain predecessor history and transfer priority/context/NOW atomically.

negative.prompt: Delete every provider conversation and transcript.
Read a cloud-only session on a computer that is not connected.
Everything looks idle, so assume all the work is finished.

review.commerce_description: Gajendra does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Shared local backend and prepared reads; faster bounded provider refresh; explicit work lifecycle and review Undo; native/plugin motion feedback and keyboard/reduced-motion support.
